name: Well-Known Files
description: nginx serving the mobile app association files under /.well-known/, rendered from the operator's app identities.

MOBILE_APPLE_TEAM_ID.title: Apple Team ID
MOBILE_APPLE_TEAM_ID.description: Ten-character Team ID that signs the iOS app. Set it together with the iOS bundle identifiers; leave both empty to claim no iOS app.

MOBILE_IOS_BUNDLE_IDS.title: iOS bundle identifiers
MOBILE_IOS_BUNDLE_IDS.description: Comma-separated bundle identifiers allowed to open this site's links and complete the in-app sign-in, for example org.openmapx.app. Add the development build's identifier (with its .dev suffix) to test with it.

MOBILE_ANDROID_PACKAGES.title: Android application ids
MOBILE_ANDROID_PACKAGES.description: Comma-separated application ids allowed to open this site's links and complete the in-app sign-in. Set them together with the certificate fingerprints; leave both empty to claim no Android app.

MOBILE_ANDROID_CERT_SHA256.title: Android signing certificate SHA-256
MOBILE_ANDROID_CERT_SHA256.description: Comma-separated SHA-256 fingerprints (AA:BB:… form) of the certificates the installed app is signed with. For Play distribution, use the Play app-signing certificate, not the upload key.

OPENMAPX_MEMORY_MIB.title: Container memory limit (MiB)
OPENMAPX_MEMORY_MIB.description: Optional Docker resource limit. Unset preserves the image manifest limit. Clear the field to restore the manifest limit.

OPENMAPX_CPU_LIMIT.title: Container CPU limit
OPENMAPX_CPU_LIMIT.description: Optional Docker resource limit. Unset preserves the image manifest limit. Clear the field to restore the manifest limit.
